plugins.name: alif-skyline
plugins.description: Alif's portfolio as a Claude theme: cobalt on pale paper by day, night-city navy by night, with a faint Kuala Lumpur skyline and ringed moon behind the chat.

plugins.name: alif-beach
plugins.description: A beach for Claude: sand and sea-glass by day, a moonlit shoreline by night, with a faint sun, drifting waves, a boat and a palm behind the chat.

plugins.name: alif-kl-day
plugins.description: A pixel-art Kuala Lumpur by day: a bright blue sky, pixel clouds and sun, a dense skyline and a grass strip.

plugins.name: alif-kl-night
plugins.description: A pixel-art Kuala Lumpur by night: stars, a crescent moon and the same dense skyline with its windows lit.

plugins.name: alif-pixel-meadow
plugins.description: A soft pixel meadow with a little orange critter at its laptop: a peach morning with drifting clouds by day, a plum starry night with fireflies by dark.

plugins.name: alif-kl-meadow
plugins.description: The Kuala Lumpur skyline in smooth vector behind the critter meadow: Petronas Twin Towers, Menara KL, The Exchange 106 and Merdeka Maybank Tower, hazy pastel by day and lit up under a plum starry sky by night.
